title: Install a TypeScript project
explanation: The SDK is the runtime dependency. tsx executes TypeScript; type=module enables ES modules. npm ci reproduces this completed app from its lockfile.
code:
mkdir my-agent
cd my-agent
npm init -y
npm pkg set type=module
npm install @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.310
npm install --save-dev tsx typescript @types/node
mkdir sample-workspace
"Hello, students!" | Set-Content sample-workspace/notes.txt

title: Pass the key through the process environment
explanation: The terminal sample does not load .env. It checks the inherited environment before creating a query. npm run sample:env explicitly loads the optional local file instead.

title: Give the agent a small directory and Glob
explanation: The fixed cwd is sample-workspace. Only Glob is available and pre-approved. Four SDK turns leave room for discovery and a final answer; one query call can contain several model turns.

title: Ask the exact first question
explanation: query receives the literal lesson prompt through DEFAULT_PROMPT and returns an async iterator. The same options power the CLI and the web lab.
code: const conversation = query({ prompt: DEFAULT_PROMPT, options: lessonOptions() });

title: Print tool activity, text and the final result
explanation: Print only human-readable text and tool names, followed by the final subtype. is_error also matters even when a subtype says success. finally closes the query object.

title: Forward selected events to the browser
explanation: The host projects text, tool calls and the final result into student-facing events. It does not send the API key or raw runtime configuration.

title: Compare answer with real local evidence
explanation: The host reads the demo directory for a labelled reference list. That reference is not supplied to query as an answer. The browser uses textContent, and the live recording verifies an actual Glob call.
